1) Background / Context

Handesk is a centralized help desk and lead management application developed by Revo Systems. It is designed to streamline the handling of customer support requests and efficiently manage team leads. The application supports multiple teams and integrates seamlessly with existing projects via a REST API.

2) Objectives

The primary objective of Handesk is to enhance customer support efficiency and lead management by providing a powerful ticketing system. It aims to facilitate communication, issue tracking, reporting, and analytics across multiple teams, allowing for better customer attention and internal team management.

3) Stakeholders & Users

- Primary Users: Customer support teams and lead management teams.
- Administrators: Individuals responsible for overseeing support processes and managing configuration settings.
- Developers: Users interested in leveraging the open-source nature for customization and feature development.

4) Functional Descriptions

- Ticket Management: Centralized ticketing system to manage customer support requests.
- Lead Management: Tools for handling and updating lead statuses, with features to assign leads to teams.
- Multiple Teams Support: Ability to manage and serve multiple teams under one account.
- Email Polling: Automatically retrieve support tickets from an inbox account.
- REST API: Easy-to-use API for integrating Handesk with other projects.
- Issue Tracking: Features to escalate tickets and link with a code issue tracker.
- Reports & Analytics: View and analyze team performance metrics.
- Multilanguage Support: User interface available in multiple languages.

5) Non-Functional Descriptions

- Open Source: Accessible for customization and community-driven enhancements.
- Scalability: Capable of scaling to accommodate growing numbers of tickets and leads.
- Usability: Intuitive interface aimed at enhancing user productivity.
- Security: Secure handling of tickets, leads, and user data.
- Reliability: Ensures consistent performance and uptime for critical customer support operations.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0050

CREATE TABLE `teams` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `token` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `remember_token` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `team_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `role` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `api_token` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `users_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tickets` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `requester_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `requester_email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `body` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `priority` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `team_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `merged_with` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `issue_tracker_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tickets_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `tickets_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `ticket_comments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `ticket_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `is_internal` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ticket_comments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`ticket_id`) REFERENCES `tickets` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `ticket_comments_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `ticket_tags` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `ticket_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `tag` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ticket_tags_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`ticket_id`) REFERENCES `tickets` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `ticket_attachments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `ticket_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `comment_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `filename` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `path` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `mime_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `size` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ticket_attachments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`ticket_id`) REFERENCES `tickets` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `ticket_attachments_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`comment_id`) REFERENCES `ticket_comments` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `leads` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `company` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `team_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `leads_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `leads_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `lead_notes` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `lead_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `lead_notes_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`lead_id`) REFERENCES `leads` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `lead_notes_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `settings` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `key` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `value` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `email_accounts` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `team_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `host` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `port` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `encryption` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_polled_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `email_accounts_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `reports` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `team_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `report_date` date NOT NULL,
  `tickets_opened` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `tickets_closed` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `avg_response_time` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `reports_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `reports_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
